description: Assign a customer tag to a member (assigned=true) or remove it (assigned=false). Fully reversible. Tag ids come from momence_list_tags. Momence: POST / DELETE /api/v2/host/members/{memberId}/tags/{tagId}.

assigned.description: true to assign the tag, false to remove it.

name: momence_set_member_tag
title: Tag or untag a member
